## Description

On main's full E2E gate at `fa2b578367a8e4aeef68cdd98ff854921291a7ba` (run 39548087982), `terminal-consistency-faults.spec.ts` › *high-volume numbered output reaches the parser exactly once over P2P* failed with:

```
Error: a line was delivered more than once
+ Received + Array [ 3001, 3002, 3003, ... ]
```

**1,608 duplicated tail lines, a contiguous block starting at 3001** — exactly the retained-tail window (COUNT=5000, TAIL=2000). The same test passed on retry in that run and in the selected lane at the same SHA, so it is load/timing dependent, not a constant.

The run's gate step passed (flaky tolerated), but the per-ID attestation failed: *"full Playwright report is not an all-Pass run"* — so main's full E2E is red and every issue whose SC-03/SC-04 requires merge-SHA E2E Pass is blocked.

## Reproduction

- Full E2E gate on main (`./gates/run e2e-playwright`, 253 tests), not the selected lane.
- Artifact: `visual-snapshot-diffs/test-results/terminal-consistency-fault-44a86-arser-exactly-once-over-P2P/error-context.md` in run 39548087982.
- Selected-lane runs of the same spec at the same SHA passed.

## Investigation Status

Root cause not verified. The duplicate block is a contiguous prefix of the tail, which reads as a **replay applied on top of an already-parsed buffer** rather than a producer duplicate:

- Candidate trigger: the P2P liveness probe (5 s deadline) can time out while the Agent connection is saturated by the burst; `reportUnresponsive()` tears the socket down and the runtime re-attaches. Nothing in the fixture forces this; it is timing.
- Candidate owner: on the re-attach, the runtime resumes from the renderer's parser-applied cursor and the Agent replays events from there. `TerminalController` replaces the buffer only for a *verified* cut (`BOOTSTRAP_BUFFER_RESET`); a screen-only/truncated path uses `BOOTSTRAP_SCREEN_RESET` and then appends the replayed stream. Any event the parser had already received/displayed but not yet applied (delivery ran ahead of parse) is then written twice.
- The reconciler is supposed to discard duplicates at/below the applied cursor; the duplicate range sits *above* `appliedThrough`, so it is replayed as "not yet parsed" even though the glyphs are already in the buffer — the applied cursor is the wrong dedupe frontier for what is *displayed*.

## Impact

- The exactly-once guarantee (#1645 SC-10 / #1926 SC-05) is false under load on the P2P route.
- Main's full E2E attestation fails, blocking every merge-SHA E2E criterion (including #2157 SC-03).

## Fix Direction

Decide the correct dedupe frontier for a resumed replay (parser-applied vs. parser-received/displayed) and make the re-attach path either:

1. replace the buffer with a verified atomic prefix when the replay covers already-displayed events, or
2. discard replayed frames at/below the renderer's displayed frontier, and declare the gap explicitly if the replay cannot prove continuity.

Do not weaken the fixture's duplicate assertion; reproduce deterministically first (force an under-burst re-attach in the fixture) so the owner is proven.

## Location

- `web/src/platform/terminal-runtime/controller/TerminalController.ts` — bootstrap reset choice (`BOOTSTRAP_BUFFER_RESET` vs `BOOTSTRAP_SCREEN_RESET`)
- `web/src/platform/session-runtime/SessionRuntime.ts` — resume/applied cursor, re-attach seed
- `web/src/platform/terminal-runtime/StreamReconciler.ts` — duplicate suppression frontier
- `web/src/platform/session-runtime/SessionRuntime.ts` — `probeLivenessNow` / `runLivenessProbe` (under-burst timeout)
- `e2e/tests/browser/terminal-consistency-faults.spec.ts` — the failing witness

### Success Criteria

- [x] SC-01 A reconnect during a high-volume P2P burst leaves every retained tail line exactly once in xterm's buffer — no duplicate from a replay appended over already-parsed output, and no missing line.
- [x] SC-02 The fixture reproduces the defect deterministically before the fix (an under-burst liveness timeout forces the re-attach), and the same fixture passes after it.
- [ ] SC-03 Exact PR HEAD Quality / E2E / Case Smoke / trusted Acceptance, and the merge SHA `d8b1e77fe29a86df3fdb7f5c69e61255ee2631c5` — an ancestor of every later acceptance target — shows Quality, E2E and Cases completed success plus a completed-success Acceptance / Orchestrator workflow_run (run 39562178384, reconcile-completed-quality-e2e).
